ValidationRule.description: Blocks assigning a Vehicle to a full Showroom. Fires on insert or Showroom change only. Relies on Showroom.Vehicle_Count__c (Flow-maintained, Stage 8) — inert until that Flow exists. See DISCOVERY_LOG.md.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Showroom__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( Showroom__r.Capacity__c ) ), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Showroom__c ) ), Showroom__r.Vehicle_Count__c >= Showroom__r.Capacity__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Showroom is already at capacity. Choose a different Showroom or increase its Capacity.
